messages:
Ana: Quick idea — add an inline 'Troubleshoot' accordion inside the Private setup network step. collapsed by default, expands for failed probes. Thoughts?
Matt: sounds good. collapsed keeps the step compact. when probes fail we should auto-open and highlight the failing check. add a small 'Copy command' CTA next to each suggestion. :gear:
Laura: a11y: if we auto-open on failure, ensure focus is moved into the panel (focus management) and that there's a clear skip link back to the stepper actions. use aria-expanded on the accordion trigger.
Suresh: implementation notes: avoid rendering heavy logs until expanded. for auto-open on failure, debounce so transient failures don't spam opens. we can emit analytics.event('troubleshoot_open','reason') for feature telemetry.
Ana: copy draft for collapsed hint: "Troubleshoot connection issues". inside: "Can't reach the host? Try: check firewall rules, confirm CIDR & route, verify outbound SSH (port 22)." Add link "Show diagnostic commands" -> help drawer. ok?
Matt: tweak: replace 'outbound SSH' with 'outgoing SSH (port 22)' — less ambiguous for ops. and change header to "Troubleshoot common network issues"
Laura: also use visible icons + sr-only text for status (don't rely on color). for the open/close affordance, include an aria-live polite region that narrates "Troubleshoot expanded" when it opens, but only announce once per open to avoid noise.
Suresh: note about live region: put the live region outside the collapsed container so screenreaders get updates even if content is hidden. or only attach it after expansion as Laura suggested earlier.
Ana: UX edgecases: what if user manually collapsed but probes later fail? should we auto-open? proposal: auto-open only on first-run or when user hasn't manually dismissed. persist dismissal in localStorage per user.
Matt: Figma mock incoming with 3 variants: compact collapsed, auto-open on fail, and full help drawer. posting link in a few hours.
Laura: I'll add checklist items: focus trap avoidance, keyboard toggle order, aria-expanded & aria-controls, live region placement, non-color indicators, contrast for pill backgrounds, readable link text.
